scope: QTR-01 Model Associations research; F50 new exploratory mechanism; does not amend F49 or use its observed worlds as independent replication

hypothesis.question: Can non-gradient, native causal-template composition learn from novel three-step interventions and transfer associations to fully unseen causal laws better than fully source-trained law-conditioned conventional meta-learners and Bayesian grammar search?
hypothesis.mechanism: Native tokenless causal-slot graphs plus contradiction-gated local rule assembly, limited reversible evidence and deterministic intervention witnesses; never receives target law graph or AST; independent research layer, not Yggdrasil accepted model
hypothesis.anti_leak: Use no F49 generation namespaces, F49 data, F49 development feedback, external language donor activations, hidden weights or model architecture replacement
non_falsifiable_claims_prohibited: scientific generalization from nine development worlds

task.data_generating_law: 3-step binary causal mechanisms, 10 action bits at each time step, 3 context bits constant per episode, lag-1 and lag-2 effects; deterministic ordered interventions and binary consequential outcomes each step; 0.10 independent deterministic bit-flip noise for public outcomes, clean evaluator-only counterfactual truth
task.source_training: 64 fixed three-step episodes per source law, deterministic FIT/VALIDATION partition by whole source law (80/20), no leaking held-out validation-law labels as source-training examples. Public FIT grammar AST/DAG and every public FIT episode with observed outcomes presented identically to native, Bayesian and conventional arms; conventional trained by episodic meta-learning rather than unconditioned mixed-label fitting. VALIDATION used for predetermined early-stopping only, never as target-learning evidence
task.source_program_grammar: Boolean AND/OR/XOR/NOT, context-conditioned gating, lag-1/lag-2 causal inputs, max source depth 3; enumerate distinct full functions with canonical ROBDD or independently verified exact symbolic equivalence, never a small sampled-probe surrogate
task.target_program_grammar: Novel functional composition depth 4 to 6, law-family-specific interaction involving at least 3 action bits, context and a delayed input; no source-bank duplicate or trivial direct-identity coding; evaluator-only law AST and signatures
task.functional_admission: Every source and target is functionally distinct by exact symbolic canonical equivalence across the full action/context/lag domain, with positive intervention contrasts; if computational admission cannot prove this, reject TASK_INVALID and do not generate outcomes
task.input_parity: All arms receive exactly the same FIT source-law DAGs, FIT source actions/outcomes, causal primitive vocabulary and same public candidate trajectory pool; no target AST/ID, evaluator labels, or external representations. Each arm chooses its own actions but receives at most 3 observed bits per selected trajectory. Conventional encoders must receive the full lossless source-law graph and episodic input in a trainable graph-conditioned form.
task.negative_controls: Shuffled public labels, randomized candidate construction (same proposal count), no retained causal slots, permuted action-consequence alignment, and source-label/target leakage canary. Any performant negative control invalidates causal-learning interpretation.

arms.native: Non-gradient tokenless local causal-slot graph/composition learner; initially only public FIT source and grammar; deterministic maximum 2048 proposals per observed trajectory, contradiction-gated updates, fixed memory and cold-restoration policy; no F49 post-outcome rule tuning
arms.graph_conditioned_gru: Fully fitted source-law graph encoder plus 128-state GRU episodic meta-learner trained with Adam lr 0.001, batch 128, up to 200 epochs, patience 20, seed 11, source-law-disjoint validation. All source FIT laws and episodes available; all target updates from public observed bits only.
arms.law_conditioned_set_mlp: Fully fitted 2-layer width-128 source-law graph-and-episode set encoder, same Adam/batch/max epoch/patience/seed and disjoint-law validation as GRU. No target AST input.
arms.graph_conditioned_logistic: Regularized causal-feature logistic control with full explicit source-law/DAG feature access, L2 0.001, deterministic full-batch solver, max iterations 500, tol 1e-8.
arms.exact_source_bank_bayes: Exact noise-posterior over all public source FIT laws with maximum entropy action choice; no target law source-bank membership oracle; charge every source-bank prediction access.
arms.compositional_grammar_bayes: Bayesian primitive composition grammar with the same action, observation, source program and proposal budgets, fixed prior exp(-1.5*node_count), known 0.10 noise likelihood.
arms.random: Seeded independent uniform sampling without replacement from common public trajectory pool, native predictor updated from its own observations.
arms.uniform: Fixed index order without replacement from common public trajectory pool, native predictor updated from its own observations.

frozen_metrics.primary: Mean clean held-out binary prediction accuracy across nine DEV worlds at 32 trajectory queries; compare native with best SINGLE control mean across all conventional, Bayesian, random, uniform arms, not an easy chosen subset
frozen_metrics.headroom_reject_if: All arms >=0.95 B32 in every development world, or strongest fully-trained conventional <0.55 B32. Reject TASK_INVALID or TASK_HEADROOM_INVALID before any GO, preserving observations without rerunning seeds.
frozen_metrics.cost: Track entire full-source training, source-graph preprocessing, adaptation, action choice, evaluator inference, cold restoration, memory bytes, optimizer steps and hypothesis accesses; exact-key caches must include source SHA/tree, grammar, seeds, training examples, toolkit, harness, platform
frozen_metrics.budget: Use one bounded build, shared pinned FIT source cache, high-first size 4096 then 2048 then 1024; 60 minute cap for 4096 source fitting per conventional model, 20 minutes per 4096 world per arm; report RESOURCE_STOP without size/seed substitution or post-result tuning
frozen_metrics.decision: DEV_F50_GO only when every preregistered positive, negative, cost, novelty, admission and retention requirement passes. Otherwise DEV_F50_NO_GO, TASK_INVALID, or RESOURCE_STOP. No scientific pass from DEV worlds; independent new protected study with separate authorization required before any promotion.

custody.note: This is an exploratory design informed by the F49 negative result, not an independent replication. All protected/reserved F49 and WSP cohorts remain outside F50.
